response.original_title: [Add-Passenger] How do I add a Passenger to my Icon of the sea Cruise
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Icon of the Seas booking +1-866-254-7549, you need to contact Royal Caribbean Customer Service at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), or reach out to your travel advisor, as online modifications are not supported +1-866-254-7549.Key Requirements Capacity & Limits: Your stateroom must have an available extra bed, and the ship must be under total capacity  +1-866-254-7549 and muster station limits. Reservation Rule: At least one original guest must remain on the booking +1-866-254-7549. Details to Prepare: Have your reservation number +1-866-254-7549, sailing date, and the new passenger's personal details ready. Cost: The addition will be repriced at prevailing fare rates plus taxes and fees.
